jobs.occupation: Lead Technical Facility Services (m/f/d)  - direct placement (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
DEKRA Arbeit GmbH, as part of DEKRA SE, is one of the top 10 personnel
service providers in Germany and one of the fastest-growing staffing
service providers in Europe.

With more than 120 locations across Germany and Europe, we are
committed to establishing flexible staffing solutions and making a
positive contribution to the regional labor market.

Help us continue to expand this successful business model and apply
today!

As one of the most successful and innovative personnel service
providers in Germany, we are currently looking for a Lead Technical
Facility Services (m/f/d) on behalf of our renowned client in Dresden,
starting as soon as possible, as part of a direct placement.

 

As a Lead Technical Facility Services (m/f/d), you will play a key
technical role in supporting international customers. You will be
responsible for installing, commissioning, qualifying and optimizing
advanced technical systems and providing hands-on technical support at
customer sites.

Working closely with engineering teams, you will use your technical
expertise to ensure excellent system performance and contribute to the
continuous improvement and development of products.

The position involves extensive travel throughout Europe, as well as a
willingness to participate in product training programs in the United
States.

 

Your responsibilities

- Install, commission and qualify abatement systems at customer sites
across Europe
- Deliver certified customer training for Cyclone and Encompass
systems
- Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues
- Provide expert technical support directly at customer sites
- Conduct field testing and collect system performance data
- Support process and product optimization initiatives
- Collaborate closely with engineering teams on product development,
testing and continuous improvement projects
- Ensure compliance with all company safety, quality and operational
standards

Your qualifications

- Degree or technical qualification in Electrical Engineering,
Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field
- Extensive professional experience as a Field Service Engineer /
Service Engineer in an international environment
- Ideally, experience within the semiconductor, process or high-tech
manufacturing industry
- Strong troubleshooting and technical diagnostic skills
- Ability to read and interpret electrical, mechanical and pneumatic
schematics
- Experience using test equipment, measuring instruments and hand
tools
- Fluent German and English
- Excellent communication and training skills
- Willingness to travel extensively throughout Europe
- Willingness to participate in product training programs in the
United States

 

What the position offers

- Permanent employment
- International and technically challenging working environment
- Opportunity to work within the high-tech / semiconductor industry
- Varied assignments at international customer sites
- Close cooperation with engineering and development teams
- Opportunity to contribute to product optimization and technical
development
- International product training, including training programs in the
United States
 

 

How to Apply:

If you would like to apply directly, you are welcome to send us your
CV by email or submit your details via our online application. When
applying online, you can simply upload your CV after entering your
contact details. It only takes 1 minute. Why not apply today?

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer Awareness und Prevention (m/w/d) - Essen (GER) or Madrid (SP) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Company

Through its Rothe Erde, Uhde and Polysius businesses as well as the majority investment thyssenkrupp nucera, Decarbon Technologies delivers innovative, cutting-edge technologies for the transition to a climate-neutral industrial economy. Rothe Erde is a leading provider of bearings and solutions that play a key role in wind, solar and tidal power plants, among other things. With its solutions for decarbonization, defossilization and the circular economy, Uhde is a technology and implementation provider of large-scale plants for the chemical industry. Polysius supplies green technologies for the cement and lime industry, digital automation solutions, and on-site and remote maintenance services. thyssenkrupp nucera is a global supplier of electrolysis technology for the industrial-scale production of clean hydrogen. The segment employs around 12,000 people, who generated revenues of approximately 3.8 billion euros in fiscal year 2023/2024.

Your responsibilities

- You will actively contribute to the further development and effective implementation of the Compliance Management System within the Decarbon Technologies segment and take ownership of selected compliance areas, including anti-corruption, data compliance, anti-money laundering, and export control/trade compliance. A key focus of your role will be the provision of antitrust and competition law advice as well as the further development and implementation of competition law compliance measures.
- You will help ensure that segment-wide standards are adhered to, compliance risks are identified at an early stage, and regulatory requirements are implemented efficiently across the organization.
- As part of a holistic compliance approach, you will advise and support the business on additional compliance topics, particularly with regard to the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) and related regulatory requirements.
- You will advise the companies within the thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies segment on a broad range of compliance matters. This includes, among other things, providing antitrust and competition law advice in MundA projects, addressing liability-related questions arising from the application of the Compliance Program, and supporting the coordination and enablement of Compliance Officers in the Business Units and regions. In doing so, you will contribute to the effective and consistent implementation of compliance requirements throughout the segment.
- You will support compliance reporting at segment and Group level, assist in the development of compliance processes, policies, concepts, and preventive measures, and accompany their implementation in an international environment.
- You will monitor and analyze regulatory developments and compliance risks, derive appropriate measures, and support their implementation.
- In addition, you will independently manage cross-functional compliance projects and actively drive the further development of the compliance organization and compliance culture within the segment.

Your profile

- You are passionate about working collaboratively and excited to contribute to the further evolution of Compliance at thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies during a period of transformation and growth.
- You hold an degree in Law and have successfully completed the Second German State Examination (Second State Exam) or possess an equivalent legal qualification. Additional qualifications, such as an LL.M. or other postgraduate degree, are considered an asset.
- You bring significant and recent experience in a senior compliance role within an international corporation or complex business environment. You have a proven track record of not only advising on compliance matters, but also shaping, implementing, and continuously improving compliance programs and governance frameworks.
- You have extensive expertise in the design, implementation, and enhancement of Compliance Management Systems (CMS).
- You have substantial experience advising on competition and antitrust law matters in an international business context, including cooperation agreements, distribution structures, public tenders, and MundA transactions.
- Your expertise covers key compliance areas, including competition law, anti-corruption, data protection and digital regulation, anti-money laundering, and trade compliance.
- You combine strong legal and regulatory knowledge with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions.
- You are an effective communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and credibility across all levels of the organization.
- You thrive in an international and cross-cultural environment and distinguish yourself through integrity, discretion, resilience, and a high level of personal accountability.
- You have successfully led complex, cross-functional, and international projects and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
- You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. German and Spanisch language skills are highly desirable.

Your benefits

At thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies, we are committed to providing an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Our benefits include:

- The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing to the continued growth and success of thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies in a dynamic and future-oriented industry.
- A competitive compensation package combined with attractive benefits.
- Flexible working hours, hybrid and mobile working arrangements, and the opportunity, subject to agreement, to work remotely from within the European Union for up to 20 days per year.
- A wide range of health and wellbeing initiatives, including confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services, preventive healthcare offerings through our occupational health service (such as health screenings and seasonal vaccinations), and various sports and wellness programs.
- Extensive professional and personal development opportunities through a broad portfolio of training programs, learning initiatives, and career opportunities across the thyssenkrupp Group.
- A structured and personalized onboarding program designed to help you settle in quickly and build a strong network from day one.

Contact

thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies GmbH
Sofie Putschke
Human Resources

We value diversity

We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Planner (gn) – External Manufacturing (Servicefachkraft - Dialogmarketing)
jobs.description:
Start: From 01/01/2027 | Level: Intermediate | Location: Hamburg | Working hours: Full-time (40h/week)Your start in the Operations Team at  ESN und More!  As a Supply Planner (all genders) – External Manufacturing, you are responsible for the availability of our externally manufactured products as well as a smooth purchase-order-to-invoice process in SAP. You bring experience in supply planning or procurement and are excited to drive the ESN und More Nutrition brands forward? Then get in touch and become part of the team.
Your mission
✓ You secure the availability of our externally manufactured products (co-manufacturers und suppliers) for ESN und More Nutrition
✓ You translate the demand plan into supply, purchase and replenishment plans and proactively steer suppliers
✓ You plan supplier capacity in the mid- to long-term and identify bottlenecks early on
✓ You own the full purchase-order-to-invoice process (PO-to-invoice) in SAP MM, including resolving quantity and price discrepancies
✓ You coordinate volumes, terms and pricing topics operationally with Strategic Procurement
✓ You drive process improvements and automation across the planning and order-to-invoice workflow

Your experience und skills
✓ You hold a degree in supply chain, business administration or industrial engineering – or equivalent practical experience
✓ You bring at least 3 years of experience in supply planning, procurement operations or contract manufacturing
✓ You have hands-on SAP experience (MM, PO-to-invoice); knowledge of o9, Kinaxis or SAP APO/IBP is a plus
✓ You are confident using Excel and planning systems and think analytically
✓ You work in a structured, proactive and hands-on way, with strong communication and stakeholder skills
✓ You speak business-fluent German and fluent English

Why choose us?

Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,200 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.

You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, and Elsdorf, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:
✓ Flexible working hours and remote work options
✓ Attractive employee discounts
✓ Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass
✓ Workation
✓ Corporate benefits
✓ 28 days vacation/year
✓ and much more

About Us

The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands ESN and More Nutrition since 2021.

ESN has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017, More Nutrition focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.

TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. Its agile company culture and exciting career opportunities make TQG a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees.

Postdocs (2 years) (m,f,x)

The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computerscience, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in an unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 years
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-11-09

- Our goal is to attract postdoctoral researchers and enable them to conducttheir research with the mentorship of a PI. We expect that within the durationof this contract, candidates will be able to achieve independent achievementsin research, e.g through publications or joint research endeavours.

Your profile:

- An above-average doctoral degree in computer science, electricalengineering, mathematics, psychology (preferably with a relationship totechnology) or related disciplines is mandatory for the application.
- Fluent spoken and written English is also required.
- In addition, applicants should have basic knowledge of one or more of theresearch areas relevant to CASA: Cryptography, system security, hardwaresecurity, decentralized security, human-centered security, Al and security.
- Postdoctoral students should already have published relevant papers attheleading conferences in cryptography and computer security research, aslisted e.g. at http://csrankings.org/.

jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation.
We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let's create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

- As Senior Project Lead (m/f/d) you collaborate with colleagues on complex strategy consulting projects and provide impactful solutions for businesses and functions across BASF.
- You identify potential improvements in each project and advise the management team competently and empathetically.
- From Day 1, you apply your skills and contribute your ideas to ongoing projects.
- You communicate clearly and openly with all parties involved throughout all project phases.
- Our end-to-end consulting services allow you to accompany a project from start to finish.
- You enjoy top management visibility by working with BASF Executives globally on a wide range of strategic high-priority projects with sustainable impact.

Our projects cover the fields of Innovation & Growth, Marketing & Sales, Organizational Excellence, and Post-Merger Integration/Carve Out. For an overview about our practice groups see here.

- professional experience in strategic consulting and project work in a (global) strategy consulting firm
- depending on your qualifications and professional experience, you start as Project Leader (3-5 years) or Senior Project Leader (5-7 years)
- proven expertise in project management methods as well as consulting methodologies and approaches
- excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus
- convincing and competent behavior in client interactions
- open-minded and inclusive attitude, reliable team player
- international work experience is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

- Attractive location: Your work location is in Monheim (near Düsseldorf), the administrative headquarters of BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. The Monheim office has a canteen and modern, flexible workspaces designed to accommodate various teams and functions.
- Hybrid Work: You can combine remote work with up to 3 office days. Regular visits of our headquarters in Ludwigshafen are required, e.g. for monthly team days or unit events. Depending on the project/client, journeys to other BASF sites may be necessary as well.
- Work-Life-Balance: We offer access to childcare providers, flexible working time models, and cooperations with fitness and health studios, along with numerous other (preventive) offers for your mental and physical health.
- Personal Growth: We provide a comprehensive training program tailored to your needs. Our unit has a successful track record in employee career development: former team members can be found at all hierarchy levels at BASF globally. Individual support for your professional development is part of our mission.
- Perks: An attractive salary and a variable bonus, employee stock options, the possibility of special leave, 30 days of paid vacation, canteens with freshly cooked food, job bike, social counselling, and many others.

jobs.occupation: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) (Fachkaufmann/-frau - Einkauf und Logistik)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) Are
you ready to secure the supply chain for Europe’s pioneer
semiconductor Greenfield project? As a Global Procurement Specialist /
Strategic Buyer, you will take ownership of the commercial end-to-end
sourcing process for critical materials supporting our brand-new
manufacturing site in Dresden. You will negotiate high-volume global
contracts, mitigate supply chain risks, and build resilient
partnerships with key international suppliers. If you thrive at the
intersection of business strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and
high-tech operations, this role offers you the ultimate platform to
make a global impact. Tasks Strategic Sourcing: Develop, negotiate,
and execute end-to-end global sourcing strategies and contracts to
ensure a highly resilient, cost-effective supply of critical
materials. Supplier Partnership Management: Build and nurture
long-term strategic relationships with a global supplier base to
secure high-quality materials and services. Commercial Negotiation:
Lead commercial negotiations, drive total cost of ownership (TCO)
optimization, and actively manage commercial risks. Performance
Monitoring : Evaluate and manage supplier performance against key
quality, delivery, cost, and risk metrics to ensure full contract
compliance. Risk & Supply Resilience: Proactively identify and resolve
supplier-related issues, including delivery disruptions and quality
deviations, using data-driven preventive actions. Cross-Functional
Alignment: Collaborate closely with engineering, fab operations,
finance, and HQ procurement teams to align sourcing activities with
production budgets and timelines. Process Excellence: Contribute to
continuous improvement initiatives to streamline procurement workflows
and scale up supply chain operations. Governance & ESG: Ensure strict
compliance with all internal policies, contractual obligations, trade
laws, and ESG standards across all purchasing activities. Profile
Required: Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Supply Chain
Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, IT, or a
related field. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of strategic procurement
or supply chain experience within an international industrial setting.
Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in commercial negotiations,
contract management, and strategic supplier evaluation. Languages:
Proficiency in English (C1) and German (C1) is required for seamless
collaboration with local and global stakeholders. Mindset: Strong
analytical thinking, attention to detail in contract review, and the
ability to coordinate multiple complex projects simultaneously.
International Onboarding: Willingness to complete an intensive
training of 3-6 months at TSMC Taiwan. Nice to have: Industry
Knowledge: Prior experience in the semiconductor, chemical, or
advanced materials industry. Certifications: Professional supply chain
or procurement certifications (e.g., APICS CPIM/CSCP, ISM CPSM).
Global Mindset: Experience in collaborating with Asian business
environments; Mandarin language skills are a plus. Why Join ESMC? Help
build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe.
Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across the
world. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
Additional contact details Please apply with an English resume.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Trial Disclosure Lead (m/w/d) (Referent/in - klinische Studien (CRA))
jobs.description:
Randstad is one of the world's leading talent companies with the
ambition to be the world's most equitable and specialized talent
company. Through our "partner for talent" corporate strategy, we find,
develop and connect specialized talents with companies - worldwide,
locally and always at a high speed. We build high-quality, diverse,
and agile teams, while individuals can enjoy a rewarding career path
with equitable opportunities.

Randstad Professional is one of Randstad's four specializations
and focuses on the placement of specialists and managers in the
future-oriented sectors of IT, Engineering, Life Science and Office.

Are you passionate about transparency in clinical research and eager
to ensure that global study data meets the highest regulatory
standards?

We are currently looking for a Clinical Trial Disclosure Lead (m/f/d)
for our pharmaceutical client in Monheim am Rhein (fully remote
possible). In this role, you will independently manage the entire
process of clinical trial registration and results disclosure at the
study level.

This position is available via temporary employment
(Arbeitnehmerüberlassung) for 18 months, with the option of contract
extension.

- ​​Strategy & Planning: Define disclosure strategies early at
study concept, protocol, and amendment stages.
- Registrations & Submissions: Prepare, review, and submit clinical
trial registrations across global registries such as CTIS and
ClinicalTrials.gov.
- Lifecycle Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date, and compliant
registry records throughout the entire study lifecycle.
- Results Disclosures: Coordinate the creation and submission of
clinical trial results disclosures.
- Compliance & Audits: Ensure full inspection readiness through
precise documentation and auditable evidence.
- Operations & Oversight: Support data quality, system maintenance,
and vendor oversight activities.
- Remote: 3 days/week or 100% remote possible
- Education & Experience: Degree in Life Sciences (or a related
discipline) with a background in clinical research, trial management,
Regulatory Affairs, or project management.
- Technical Expertise: Knowledge of clinical trial transparency and
disclosure requirements, familiarity with registries such as CTIS or
ClinicalTrials.gov, and strong affinity for IT systems. (Experience at
a CRO or Sponsor is a plus).
- Languages: Fluent English (must-have); German skills are a
nice-to-have.
- Soft Skills: High attention to detail, strong organizational
skills, proactive communication, and an open, collaborative mindset.
- Attractive salary and long-term job security through affiliation
with the Group
- Up to 30 days vacation per year
- Good chances of being taken on by our business partners
- Targeted training opportunities and free language courses

the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Chemical Quality & Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) Are you
ready to design, build, and run a state-of-the-art analytical
chemistry laboratory from the ground up? As a Chemical Quality &
Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you will be key to establishing
our chemical laboratory infrastructure in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will manage our analytical instruments, set up
testing standards, and verify the quality of incoming materials and
facility chemical systems. Collaborating closely with our advanced
teams in Taiwan and leading a small group of local technicians, you
will directly safeguard the production quality of Europe's newest
premier semiconductor fab! Tasks Lab Infrastructure Setup: Design,
establish, and optimize our on-site chemical lab capacity, process
setups, and analytical capabilities. Instrument Management: Lead the
operation, calibration, and maintenance of high-precision analytical
equipment, with a focus on ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, and Ion
Chromatography (IC). Material Quality Control: Execute routine and
event-triggered monitoring of incoming chemicals and raw materials to
ensure strict compliance with manufacturing standards. Technical
Writing: Define Operational Instructions (OIs) and Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs) for the laboratory environment. Team Leadership:
Supervise, train, and coordinate a small, dedicated group of
laboratory technicians. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with
fab and facility teams to troubleshoot chemical events, support
continuous improvement projects (CIP), and verify tool certifications.
Emergency On-Duty Support: Participate in weekend and night-shift
on-duty rotations to handle urgent chemical safety or quality
escalations. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s
degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, or a
related scientific discipline. Technical Experience: 0 to 3 years of
hands-on experience in chemical analysis, with deep knowledge of
analytical techniques such as ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, or Ion
Chromatography (IC). Analytical Skillset: Experience in standard
sample preparation, calibration curves, statistical process control
(SPC) data interpretation, and analytical instrument troubleshooting.
Soft Skills: Strong collaborative mindset, intercultural openness,
resilience under pressure, and a structured, detail-oriented approach
to safety and quality. Languages: Fluency in English (written and
spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Prior experience in a semiconductor
manufacturing environment or cleanroom chemical lab management.
Knowledge of European chemical regulations (such as REACH) and safety
standards. Basic programming skills (e.g., Python, R, or SQL) for
analytical data processing. Basic communication skills in German
and/or Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent
employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of
Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center,
gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating
complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training,
while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An
annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports
classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

jobs.description:
Would you like to do more than simply observe and instead actively contribute to challenging transformation projects in an international environment?

Who We Are

We are a specialized boutique consultancy in the field of digital transformation, with a focus on:

- Process management
- Project management
- Quality assurance in ERP projects
- ERP solution architecture in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment
- Data analytics and business intelligence

Our projects are primarily conducted in international contexts and combine functional, technical and organizational perspectives.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for motivated seasoned veterans (m/f/d) who have extensive professional experience and would like to learn something new in the areas of project management (Office) and control tower functions in ERP implementation projects.

What You Should Bring

- Curiosity and intrinsic motivation to learn something new again
- A strong willingness to learn and work independently
- Interest in digital business processes and ERP systems
- Very good German and good English language skills, as our projects have an international focus
- A structured and analytical way of thinking

Prior experience in project management or Microsoft Dynamics 365 is beneficial, but not a mandatory requirement.

Your Responsibilities

- Supporting the analysis and optimization of business processes
- Contributing to ERP implementation projects
- Assisting with project management and quality assurance activities
- Contributing to the design and documentation of solution architectures
- Independently working on clearly defined subject areas

From the very beginning, you will work on real client projects and take on responsibility, while receiving appropriate guidance and regular professional exchange.

What We Offer

- A personal, appreciative and relaxed working and learning environment
- Plenty of freedom to independently explore new topics
- Direct collaboration with executive management
- Insights into international transformation projects
- Flexible working arrangements
- Prospects for future permanent employment

But what’s even more important is that we’ll prepare you for your new challenge. With us, you’ll receive structured on-the-job training in project management and project methodologies for ERP implementation projects, along with the corresponding certifications.

Our ambition is not only to deliver successful projects, but also to support the professional development of people.

If you are interested in growing in an entrepreneurial environment and actively contributing to digital transformation, we look forward to receiving your application, including a brief motivation letter and your CV.
